title: Reorganize Adjacent Characters
statement:
Rearrange a lowercase string so equal characters are never adjacent.

Contract
- `text` is non-null and contains lowercase English letters.
- Return any string with the same multiset of characters and no equal neighbouring characters.
- Return the empty string when no valid arrangement exists.

Examples
- `aab` may return `aba`.
- `aaab` returns the empty string.

examples.output: Any valid arrangement, such as aba

hints: A character that appears too often makes the task impossible.
Use a max-heap by remaining count and hold back the character you just placed.
Reinsert the held-back character only after placing a different one. Intended complexity: O(n log m) time for m distinct letters.
inputSyntax: Input: a lowercase string, for example: aab
